resources.string: There\'s no class running for your class yet. If the teacher is already showing the QR, you can still scan it.
Camera permission is needed to scan the class QR code.
Point the camera at the QR on your teacher\'s screen.
The QR changes every 30 seconds. Scan it straight from the teacher\'s screen, not a screenshot.
Can\'t scan? Ask your teacher to mark you manually on their device.
You\'re already recorded as %1$s for this session.
